faults.what: Spoken dialogue does not match script line 1; presenter adds extra phrases ('Kya aapko pata hai? 2,000 ka note gayab ho gaya...').
faults.fix: Re-record or edit line 1 to match the scripted dialogue verbatim.

faults.what: Abrupt audio transition from on-camera presenter acoustic room audio to studio voiceover narrator.
faults.fix: Equalize room tone and acoustics or use the same narrator voice throughout the video.

faults.what: Subtitle for the final line remains stuck on screen over the end card after narration has finished.
faults.fix: Cut caption display when narration ends at 0:47.

faults.what: AI-generated pigeons in front of the building glide and flap with unnatural physics.
faults.fix: Replace with real B-roll of the RBI building or cleaner stock footage.

faults.what: Hand applying stamp over banknote exhibits noticeable AI warping and morphing around the fingers.
faults.fix: Use authentic stock footage of official stamping.

strongest: The pacing and visual storytelling clearly explain the legal tender transition and cash deposit rules.
weakest: The jarring shift in narrator voice and audio profile between scene 1 and scene 2 breaks production consistency.
